correctness.rationale: Explicitly enumerated both product sets by rotation/reflection cosets. Odd n gives t=2a bijective; even n gives even t twice and exactly one possible involution. Counting each unordered same-coset pair with factor n/2 yields the table. The arithmetic-progression correction has exactly n/3 order-three cosets with six rather than two presentations. Direct independent brute force checks all triples for n=3 through 36 and verifies each cell; the proof handles all n.

originality.rationale: Compared the entire claimed distribution, not merely product-dominance signs, to the closest primary literature. The 2022 dihedral paper establishes a sign inequality for three-subsets but does not provide the exact four-value spectrum or complete all-n composition table.
